newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close down after tedious session.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close down after tedious session.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Dutch bonds close down but above day's lows after boring session. Dealers see no volume or direction in trade, can not give reason for massive abstinence by market players. Topic of the day is possible hike of Dutch special advances rate on Thursday as guilder weakens further against mark.
* Feb 2002 -0.12 at 116.15/25 for a bid yld of 4.53 pct.
* 10-year yield spread versus Jan 2007 Bund widens to -11 basis points from -9 on Friday.
* Jan 2023s -0.49 at 117.33/53, yielding 6.14 pct at bid.
